thag10.7:1.1: Vijāneyya sakaṃ atthaṃ, avalokeyyātha pāvacanaṃ, yañ c' ettha assa paṭirūpaṃ sāmaññaṃ ajjhupagatassa. || ||
thag10.7:2.1: mittaṃ idha kalyāṇaṃ sikkhāvipulaṃ samādānaṃ sussūsā ca garūnaṃ: etaṃ samaṇassa paṭirūpaṃ. || ||
thag10.7:3.1: buddhesu sagāravatā dhamme apaciti yathābhūtaṃ saṃghe ca cittikāro: etaṃ samaṇassa paṭirūpaṃ. || ||
thag10.7:4.1: ācāragocare yutto ājīvo sodhito agārayho cittassa saṇṭhapanaṃ: etaṃ samaṇassa paṭirūpaṃ. || ||
thag10.7:5.1: cārittaṃ atha vārittaṃ iriyāpathiyaṃ pasādaniyaṃ adhicitte ca āyogo: etaṃ . . . || || āraññakāni senāsanāni
thag10.7:6.1: pantāni appasaddāni bhajitabbāni muninā: etaṃ . . . || || sīlañ ca bāhusaccañ ca
thag10.7:7.1: dhammānaṃ pavicayo yathābhūtaṃ saccānaṃ abhisamayo: etaṃ . . . || || bhāveyya aniccan ti anattasaññaṃ
thag10.7:8.1: asubhasaññañ ca lokamhi ca anabhiratiṃ: etaṃ . . . || ||
thag10.7:9.1: bhāveyya ca bojjhaṅge iddhipādāni indriyabalāni aṭṭhaṅgamaggam ariyaṃ: etaṃ . . . || || taṇhaṃ
thag10.7:10.1: pajaheyya munī, samūlake āsave padāleyya, vihareyya vimutto: etaṃ samaṇassa paṭirūpan ti. || || Gotamo thero. uddānaṃ: Kāḷudāyī ca so thero
thag10.7:11.0: Ekavihārī ca Kappino Cūḷapanthako Kappo ca Upaseno ca Gotamo satt' ime Dasake therā, gāthāyo c' ettha sattatīti.
